docs.title: Tool reference
docs.text: This reference is generated from the production Host composition for 0.0.0-dev. The catalog is the compact machine-readable index; each tool page links to its complete MCP definition.

docs.title: Code Actions
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose list-code-actions Query CodeAction Lists bounded Roslyn code fixes and refactorings for a document, selection or caret. prepare-fix-all Query CodeAction Revalidates a Code Fix and reports the bounded impact of one explicit Fix All scope without staging changes. stage-code-action Mutation CodeAction Revalidates and stages one selected Code Fix, refactoring or prepared Fix All action into the active transaction.

docs.title: Code analysis
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose analyze-async Query CorePlugin Returns bundled AsyncFixer diagnostics and compiler diagnostic CS4014 for a selected scope. analyze-control-flow Query CorePlugin Analyzes control flow for an exact complete statement or contiguous statement range. analyze-data-flow Query CorePlugin Analyzes data flow for an exact expression, complete statement, or contiguous statement range. analyze-disposables Query CorePlugin Returns advisory findings for undisposed local disposable values. analyze-nullability Query CorePlugin Returns nullable-flow diagnostics for a selected scope or location. find-dependency-cycles Query CorePlugin Returns detected dependency cycles for the selected scope and granularity. find-duplicate-code Query CorePlugin Returns bounded duplicate executable-block pointers that normalize to the same statement sequence. find-unused-symbols Query CorePlugin Returns candidate unused locals and members from compiler diagnostics. get-change-impact Query CorePlugin Returns a bounded impact summary and supporting source locations for a symbol change. get-control-flow-graph Query CorePlugin Returns a bounded control-flow graph with operation metadata and exact source pointers. get-dependency-graph Query CorePlugin Returns a bounded dependency graph for the selected scope and granularity. get-diagnostics Query CorePlugin Returns compiler and analyzer diagnostics for a selected scope. get-document-options Query CorePlugin Returns language and optional detailed parse and analyzer-config options for a document. get-operation-tree Query CorePlugin Returns a bounded IOperation tree with metadata and exact source pointers. get-symbol-dependencies Query CorePlugin Returns the direct symbols used by a resolved symbol. get-symbol-dependents Query CorePlugin Returns symbols that directly depend on a resolved symbol. get-test-impact Query CorePlugin Returns likely impacted tests for a resolved symbol.

docs.title: Code discovery and navigation
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose find-callees Query CorePlugin Returns symbols directly invoked by a method or selected executable body. find-callers Query CorePlugin Returns bounded direct source call sites and containing symbols. find-derived-types Query CorePlugin Finds derived types for a resolved base type. find-implementations Query CorePlugin Finds implementations of an interface or abstract member. find-overloads Query CorePlugin Returns overload signatures for a resolved method or constructor. find-overrides Query CorePlugin Finds overrides of a virtual or abstract member. find-references Query CorePlugin Finds source references, optionally including declarations and access classification. get-api-surface Query CorePlugin Returns exported API symbols for a selected scope. get-code-context Query CorePlugin Returns a bounded code window with the enclosing semantic context for a selected location. get-document-outline Query CorePlugin Returns a bounded semantic outline for one document. get-partial-declarations Query CorePlugin Returns the declarations for a partial type or method. get-project-details Query CorePlugin Returns project metadata, options and selected document details. get-solution-structure Query CorePlugin Returns bounded solution folders, projects, target frameworks and direct project relationships. get-symbol-attributes Query CorePlugin Returns declared and inherited attributes for a resolved symbol. get-symbol-info Query CorePlugin Returns detailed metadata for a resolved symbol. get-symbol-members Query CorePlugin Lists declared members and optional inherited or interface members for a resolved symbol. get-type-hierarchy Query CorePlugin Returns base, interface, and optional derived type relationships for a resolved type. go-to-definition Query CorePlugin Finds source or metadata definitions for a resolved symbol. resolve-symbol Query CorePlugin Resolves the symbol at a location or selection and returns its canonical selector. search-symbols Query CorePlugin Searches declarations by name, metadata name and optional semantic filters.

docs.title: Code mutation
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose format-document Mutation CorePlugin Stages Roslyn formatting for one document or one selected range. rename-symbol Mutation CorePlugin Stages a symbol rename across the effective solution.

docs.title: Error reporting
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose get-error-details Query Server Returns temporary local diagnostic details for an unexpected tool failure. The result may contain paths and user-authored identifiers, is intended only for the trusted local agent, and must never be submitted externally. prepare-error-report Query Server Creates the complete external payload without network activity. Exception messages may contain Workspace data. Present the returned destination, payload JSON string and digest to the user before calling submit-error-report when approval is required; the user can choose to remove exception messages during submission. submit-error-report Mutation Server After applying the configured consent policy, submits one previously prepared immutable external error report to its reviewed destination.

docs.title: Server lifecycle
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose server-status Query Server Returns server diagnostics without requiring a loaded workspace.

docs.title: Transactions
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose transaction-commit Mutation Server Commits the active transaction. Transactional and autonomous-trusted modes use the standard request; approval-required mode requires a transaction-review receipt and requests one-use approval for that exact change. transaction-history Mutation Server Moves backward or forward through staged transaction history. transaction-preview Query Server Previews the current staged transaction. transaction-review Query Server Reviews the exact validated persistence set and returns the receipt required to commit it. transaction-rollback Mutation Server Rolls back the current staged transaction. transaction-start Mutation Server Starts a new staged transaction. Check workspace-status first and do not mutate a workspace that is or may be in use elsewhere unless mutation ownership has been coordinated.

docs.title: Workspaces
docs.text: Tool Operation Area Purpose workspace-close Mutation Server Closes the selected workspace. workspace-list Query Server Lists the currently loaded workspaces. workspace-open Mutation Server Loads an additional writable workspace. Open only a fully trusted workspace: loading evaluates MSBuild project logic, evaluated source inputs including external linked or package-provided documents become queryable, and later diagnostic or Code Action operations can load and execute project analyzers with the Host's permissions. Documents outside workspaceRoot remain read-only. If instance status reports that the workspace is or may be in use elsewhere, use it only for necessary queries, expect results to become stale, and coordinate mutation ownership before starting a transaction. workspace-reload Mutation Server Reloads the selected workspace when it is out of date. workspace-status Query Server Reports the selected workspace lifecycle and cross-instance state. Treat a workspace that is or may be in use elsewhere as query-only, use it only when necessary, and expect results to become stale.

docs.title: Analyze Async
docs.text:
analyze-async · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns bundled AsyncFixer diagnostics and compiler diagnostic CS4014 for a selected scope.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Analyze Control Flow
docs.text:
analyze-control-flow · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Analyzes control flow for an exact complete statement or contiguous statement range.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Analyze Data Flow
docs.text:
analyze-data-flow · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Analyzes data flow for an exact expression, complete statement, or contiguous statement range.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Analyze Nullability
docs.text:
analyze-nullability · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns nullable-flow diagnostics for a selected scope or location.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Behaviour annotations
docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint false idempotentHint true openWorldHint false readOnlyHint true title "Analyze Nullability"

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description scope object | null No Selects documents or projects to analyse when location is omitted; omitted searches the loaded solution. Ignored when location is supplied. location object | null No Provide exactly one of span or selection. findingsLimit integer | null No Caps returned nullable-flow diagnostics. Omitted or null uses 50; zero returns no findings. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Find Callees
docs.text:
find-callees · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns symbols directly invoked by a method or selected executable body.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object No Symbol whose callees should be found. location object No Source location or executable region whose contained callees should be found. includeIndirect boolean No Whether reachable source callees should be traversed transitively. maxDepth integer No The maximum call depth to traverse when indirect callees are included. Direct callees are at depth one. calleesLimit integer | null No Maximum number of results to return. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Find Callers
docs.text:
find-callers · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns bounded direct source call sites and containing symbols.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Behaviour annotations
docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint false idempotentHint true openWorldHint false readOnlyHint true title "Find Callers"

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes Provide exactly one of location or documentationCommentId. scope object | null No Limits caller discovery to the selected documents or projects; omitted searches the loaded solution. includeContext boolean No Include the trimmed source line for each returned call site when available; defaults to false. callersLimit integer | null No Caps returned callers independently of the call-site limit. Omitted or null uses 100; zero returns no callers. callSitesPerCallerLimit integer | null No Caps call sites independently for each returned caller. Omitted or null uses 100; zero retains callers without call sites. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

These response locations publish returned items with explicit bounds and continuation state:

  • $/oneOf/0/properties/data/properties/callers
  • $/oneOf/0/properties/data/properties/callers/properties/items/items/properties/callSites

docs.title: Continuations and required actions
docs.text:
A response may include a structured continuation at the following schema location. Follow its tool call or user-action instruction instead of guessing how to continue:

  • $/oneOf/1/properties/continuation

find-dependency-cycles · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

find-derived-types · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Finds derived types for a resolved base type.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

docs.title: Find Duplicate Code
docs.text:
find-duplicate-code · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns bounded duplicate executable-block pointers that normalize to the same statement sequence.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Find Implementations
docs.text:
find-implementations · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Finds implementations of an interface or abstract member.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Behaviour annotations
docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint false idempotentHint true openWorldHint false readOnlyHint true title "Find Implementations"

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes Provide exactly one of location or documentationCommentId. scope object | null No Selects projects to search; a document scope searches its containing project. Omitted searches the loaded solution. implementationsLimit integer | null No Caps returned distinct implementation symbols. Omitted or null uses 100; zero returns no implementations. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Success response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (true) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. data object | null Yes Tool-specific result payload. snapshot object Yes Exact immutable workspace snapshot associated with the result, when available. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Error response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (false) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. error object Yes Structured error details when the invocation failed. continuation oneOf No Action the agent should take before retrying or continuing. diagnostics array No Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Find Overrides
docs.text:
find-overrides · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Finds overrides of a virtual or abstract member.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Find References
docs.text:
find-references · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Finds source references, optionally including declarations and access classification.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes Provide exactly one of location or documentationCommentId. scope object | null No Limits references and declarations to the selected documents or projects; omitted searches the loaded solution. includeDefinitions boolean No Include source declarations alongside references within the same result limit; defaults to true. includeContext boolean No Include the trimmed source line for each returned reference when available; declaration entries have no context. Omitted or null uses 100; zero returns no occurrences. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

find-unused-symbols · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns candidate unused locals and members from compiler diagnostics.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

docs.title: Format Document
docs.text:
format-document · Mutation · CorePlugin · Code mutation

Stages Roslyn formatting for one document or one selected range.

Availability: Published in transactional, approval-required and autonomous-trusted operational modes.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Stage document formatting
docs.text:
Workflow: Stage, review and commit one change, step 2.

Operational modes: transactional, autonomous-trusted.

Stage a concrete source change inside the active transaction before reviewing it.

Expected outcome: Formatting is staged without writing the source file and advances the transaction revision.

    "path": "src/Sample.cs"

    "workspaceId": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
    "workspaceEpoch": 1,
    "snapshotId": "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",
    "transactionRevision": 0
  },
  "workspace": {
    "alias": "sample"
  }
}

docs.title: Get API Surface
docs.text:
get-api-surface · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns exported API symbols for a selected scope.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Get Change Impact
docs.text:
get-change-impact · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns a bounded impact summary and supporting source locations for a symbol change.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes Provide exactly one of location or documentationCommentId. scope object | null No Selects documents for references and callers, and projects for override and implementation counts. A document scope uses its containing project for those counts; omitted searches the loaded solution. locationsLimit integer | null No Caps returned reference locations without limiting impact counts. Omitted or null uses 100; zero returns counts without locations. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Get Code Context
docs.text:
get-code-context · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns a bounded code window with the enclosing semantic context for a selected location.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Behaviour annotations
docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint false idempotentHint true openWorldHint false readOnlyHint true title "Get Code Context"

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description location object Yes The location selector. beforeLines integer | null No The optional number of lines to include before the selected location. afterLines integer | null No The optional number of lines to include after the selected location. includeEnclosingSymbols boolean No Whether the enclosing symbol chain should be included. includeDiagnostics boolean No Whether diagnostics should be included for the selected span. enclosingSymbolsLimit integer | null No Maximum number of enclosing symbols to return. diagnosticsLimit integer | null No Maximum number of diagnostics to return. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Success response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (true) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. data object | null Yes Tool-specific result payload. snapshot object Yes Exact immutable workspace snapshot associated with the result, when available. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Error response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (false) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. error object Yes Structured error details when the invocation failed. continuation oneOf No Action the agent should take before retrying or continuing. diagnostics array No Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Get Control Flow Graph
docs.text:
get-control-flow-graph · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns a bounded control-flow graph with operation metadata and exact source pointers.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.text: Property Type Required Description maxBlocks integer | null No The maximum number of projected basic blocks. maxRegions integer | null No The maximum number of projected flow regions. maxOperationsPerBlock integer | null No The maximum number of projected operations in each basic block. symbol object No Symbol whose control-flow graph should be returned. location object No Source location whose enclosing executable body should be graphed. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Get Dependency Graph
docs.text:
get-dependency-graph · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns a bounded dependency graph for the selected scope and granularity.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Get Error Details
docs.text:
get-error-details · Query · Server · Error reporting

Returns temporary local diagnostic details for an unexpected tool failure. The result may contain paths and user-authored identifiers, is intended only for the trusted local agent, and must never be submitted externally.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Get Operation Tree
docs.text:
get-operation-tree · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns a bounded IOperation tree with metadata and exact source pointers.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

get-partial-declarations · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

docs.title: Get Solution Structure
docs.text:
get-solution-structure · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns bounded solution folders, projects, target frameworks and direct project relationships.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Get Symbol Attributes
docs.text:
get-symbol-attributes · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns declared and inherited attributes for a resolved symbol.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Get Symbol Dependencies
docs.text:
get-symbol-dependencies · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns the direct symbols used by a resolved symbol.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Get Symbol Dependents
docs.text:
get-symbol-dependents · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns symbols that directly depend on a resolved symbol.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

Omitted or null uses 100; zero returns no dependents. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Get Symbol Info
docs.text:
get-symbol-info · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns detailed metadata for a resolved symbol.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Behaviour annotations
docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint false idempotentHint true openWorldHint false readOnlyHint true title "Get Symbol Info"

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes The symbol selector. includeDocumentation boolean No Whether XML documentation should be included. parametersLimit integer | null No Maximum number of parameters to return. declarationsLimit integer | null No Maximum number of declarations to return. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Success response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (true) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. data object | null Yes Tool-specific result payload. snapshot object Yes Exact immutable workspace snapshot associated with the result, when available. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Error response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (false) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. error object Yes Structured error details when the invocation failed. continuation oneOf No Action the agent should take before retrying or continuing. diagnostics array No Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Error response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (false) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. error object Yes Structured error details when the invocation failed. diagnostics object Yes Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation. reporting object No Error-reporting workflow available for an unhandled failure.

docs.title: Get Symbol Members
docs.text:
get-symbol-members · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Lists declared members and optional inherited or interface members for a resolved symbol.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Get Test Impact
docs.text:
get-test-impact · Query · CorePlugin · Code analysis

Returns likely impacted tests for a resolved symbol.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Behaviour annotations
docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint false idempotentHint true openWorldHint false readOnlyHint true title "Get Test Impact"

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes Provide exactly one of location or documentationCommentId. testScope object | null No Limits candidate test discovery to the selected documents or projects; omitted searches the loaded solution. includeReasons boolean No Include explanations of why each returned test may be affected; defaults to false and does not change which tests match. testsLimit integer | null No Caps returned likely impacted tests. Omitted or null uses 100; zero returns no tests. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Get Type Hierarchy
docs.text:
get-type-hierarchy · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Returns base, interface, and optional derived type relationships for a resolved type.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Behaviour annotations
docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint false idempotentHint true openWorldHint false readOnlyHint true title "Get Type Hierarchy"

docs.title: Request
docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes The symbol selector. includeDerived boolean No Whether derived types should be included. maxDepth integer No The maximum base-type and derived-type traversal depth. Direct relationships are at depth one. baseTypesLimit integer | null No Maximum number of base types to return. interfacesLimit integer | null No Maximum number of interfaces to return. derivedTypesLimit integer | null No Maximum number of derived types to return. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.text: Property Type Required Description symbol object Yes The symbol selector. definitionsLimit integer | null No Maximum number of definitions to return. expectedSnapshot object | null No Echo the snapshot returned with the data or transaction state used to construct this request. workspace object | null No Provide workspaceId, alias, path, or any combination.

docs.title: Success response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (true) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. data object | null Yes Tool-specific result payload. snapshot object Yes Exact immutable workspace snapshot associated with the result, when available. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Error response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (false) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. error object Yes Structured error details when the invocation failed. continuation oneOf No Action the agent should take before retrying or continuing. diagnostics array No Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Error response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (false) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. error object Yes Structured error details when the invocation failed. diagnostics object Yes Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation. reporting object No Error-reporting workflow available for an unhandled failure.

docs.title: Bounded collections and continuation
docs.text:
These response locations publish returned items with explicit bounds and continuation state:

  • $/oneOf/0/properties/data/properties/definitions

docs.title: Continuations and required actions
docs.text:
A response may include a structured continuation at the following schema location. Follow its tool call or user-action instruction instead of guessing how to continue:

  • $/oneOf/1/properties/continuation

docs.title: Prepare Error Report
docs.text:
prepare-error-report · Query · Server · Error reporting

Creates the complete external payload without network activity. Exception messages may contain Workspace data. Present the returned destination, payload JSON string and digest to the user before calling submit-error-report when approval is required; the user can choose to remove exception messages during submission.

docs.title: Rename Symbol
docs.text:
rename-symbol · Mutation · CorePlugin · Code mutation

Stages a symbol rename across the effective solution.

Availability: Published in transactional, approval-required and autonomous-trusted operational modes.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.text: Annotation Value destructiveHint true idempotentHint false openWorldHint false readOnlyHint false title "Rename Symbol"

docs.title: Request

docs.title: Stage the source change
docs.text:
Workflow: Review an exact change for one-use approval, step 2.

Operational modes: approval-required.

Stage one coherent mutation before producing its exact-change receipt.

Expected outcome: The rename advances the active transaction revision without writing source files.

docs.title: Resolve Symbol
docs.text:
resolve-symbol · Query · CorePlugin · Code discovery and navigation

Resolves the symbol at a location or selection and returns its canonical selector.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Search a selected workspace with a limit
docs.text:
Workflow: Find and inspect a symbol safely, step 1.

Operational modes: inspection-only, transactional, autonomous-trusted.

Find matching symbols without returning an unbounded result set.

Expected outcome: At most 25 symbols are returned and hasMore indicates whether the query found additional matches.

{
  "query": "CustomerService",
  "symbolsLimit": 25,
  "workspace": {
    "alias": "sample"
  }
}

Representative response fragment:

{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "symbols": {
      "items": [],
      "hasMore": true
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Server Status
docs.text:
server-status · Query · Server · Server lifecycle

Returns server diagnostics without requiring a loaded workspace.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Request

docs.title: Success response
docs.text: Property Type Required Description ok boolean constant (true) Yes Whether the tool invocation succeeded. data object | null Yes Tool-specific result payload. snapshot object No Exact immutable workspace snapshot associated with the result, when available. warnings array No Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.

docs.title: Stage Code Action
docs.text:
stage-code-action · Mutation · CodeAction · Code Actions

Revalidates and stages one selected Code Fix, refactoring or prepared Fix All action into the active transaction.

Availability: Published in transactional, approval-required and autonomous-trusted operational modes.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Stage a selected Code Action
docs.text:
Workflow: Discover and stage a Code Action, step 3.

Operational modes: transactional, autonomous-trusted.

Replay the selected action against its original snapshot and stage the resulting source changes.

Expected outcome: The action is replayed against the exact snapshot and its changes advance the active transaction revision.

docs.title: Commit the reviewed snapshot
docs.text:
Workflow: Stage, review and commit one change, step 4.

Operational modes: transactional, autonomous-trusted.

Write the staged files only when the transaction still matches the previewed snapshot.

Expected outcome: The commit succeeds only if the supplied snapshot still identifies the current staged revision.

{
  "expectedSnapshot": {
    "workspaceId": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
    "workspaceEpoch": 1,
    "snapshotId": "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",
    "transactionRevision": 1
  },
  "workspace": {
    "alias": "sample"
  }
}

Representative response fragment:

{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "SnapshotMismatch",
    "message": "The staged transaction no longer matches the expected snapshot."
  },
  "continuation": {
    "kind": "CallTool",
    "tool": "transaction-preview",
    "instruction": "Preview the current staged revision and ask the user to review it before committing."
  }
}

docs.title: Transaction History
docs.text:
transaction-history · Mutation · Server · Transactions

Moves backward or forward through staged transaction history.

Availability: Published in transactional, approval-required and autonomous-trusted operational modes.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Preview staged changes
docs.text:
Workflow: Stage, review and commit one change, step 3.

Operational modes: transactional, autonomous-trusted.

Inspect a focused diff before deciding whether to commit or roll back the transaction.

Expected outcome: A three-line-context diff is returned for the selected document without writing files.

docs.title: Workspace Open
docs.text:
workspace-open · Mutation · Server · Workspaces

Loads an additional writable workspace. Open only a fully trusted workspace: loading evaluates MSBuild project logic, evaluated source inputs including external linked or package-provided documents become queryable, and later diagnostic or Code Action operations can load and execute project analyzers with the Host's permissions. Documents outside workspaceRoot remain read-only. If instance status reports that the workspace is or may be in use elsewhere, use it only for necessary queries, expect results to become stale, and coordinate mutation ownership before starting a transaction.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

Operational modes: inspection-only, transactional, autonomous-trusted.

Load a trusted solution once and assign an alias that later calls can use.

docs.title: Workspace Reload
docs.text:
workspace-reload · Mutation · Server · Workspaces

Reloads the selected workspace when it is out of date.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

docs.title: Workspace Status
docs.text:
workspace-status · Query · Server · Workspaces

Reports the selected workspace lifecycle and cross-instance state. Treat a workspace that is or may be in use elsewhere as query-only, use it only when necessary, and expect results to become stale.

Availability: Built in and published in every operational mode.

Generated from Roslyn Workbench MCP 0.0.0-dev (0.0.0-dev).

              "location": {
                "description": "The optional source location of the diagnostic.",
                "type": [
                  "object",
                  "null"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "document": {
                    "description": "The resolved document.",
                    "type": [
                      "object",
                      "null"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "documentId": {
                        "description": "The document identifier.",
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "path": {
                        "description": "The normalized document path.",
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "projectId": {
                        "description": "The owning project identifier.",
                        "type": "string"
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "documentId",
                      "path",
                      "projectId"
                    ]
                  },
                  "span": {
                    "description": "The resolved text span.",
                    "type": [
                      "object",
                      "null"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "start": {
                        "description": "Zero-based UTF-16 offset.",
                        "type": "integer",
                        "minimum": 0,
                        "maximum": 2147483647
                      },
                      "length": {
                        "description": "UTF-16 code-unit length.",
                        "type": "integer",
                        "minimum": 0,
                        "maximum": 2147483647
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "line": {
                    "description": "The one-based line number.",
                    "type": "integer"
                  },
                  "column": {
                    "description": "The one-based column number.",
                    "type": "integer"
                  },
                  "snapshot": {
                    "description": "The exact immutable workspace snapshot associated with this location.",
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "workspaceId": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "format": "uuid"
                      },
                      "workspaceEpoch": {
                        "type": "integer"
                      },
                      "snapshotId": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "format": "uuid"
                      },
                      "transactionRevision": {
                        "type": [
                          "integer",
                          "null"
                        ]
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "workspaceId",
                      "workspaceEpoch",
                      "snapshotId",
                      "transactionRevision"
                    ]
                  },
                  "selector": {
                    "description": "The canonical selector that can resolve this source location again.",
                    "type": [
                      "object",
                      "null"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "span": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "document": {
                            "description": "Provide exactly one of path or documentId.",
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                              "project": {
                                "description": "Disambiguates documents with matching paths or IDs.",
                                "type": [
                                  "object",
                                  "null"
                                ],
                                "properties": {
                                  "projectId": {
                                    "type": [
                                      "string",
                                      "null"
                                    ]
                                  },
                                  "name": {
                                    "type": [
                                      "string",
                                      "null"
                                    ]
                                  },
                                  "path": {
                                    "description": "Workspace-relative path.",
                                    "type": [
                                      "string",
                                      "null"
                                    ]
                                  },
                                  "targetFramework": {
                                    "type": [
                                      "string",
                                      "null"
                                    ]
                                  }
                                }
                              },
                              "path": {
                                "description": "Workspace-relative path.",
                                "type": [
                                  "string",
                                  "null"
                                ]
                              },
                              "documentId": {
                                "description": "Workspace-local document ID.",
                                "type": [
                                  "string",
                                  "null"
                                ]
                              }
                            }
                          },
                          "range": {
                            "description": "Zero-based UTF-16 range.",
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                              "start": {
                                "description": "Zero-based UTF-16 offset.",
                                "type": "integer",
                                "minimum": 0,
                                "maximum": 2147483647
                              },
                              "length": {
                                "description": "UTF-16 code-unit length.",
                                "type": "integer",
                                "minimum": 0,

                          "range"

                    "required": [
                      "span"
                    ]
                  }
                },

                  "snapshot"
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "id",
              "message"
            ]
          },
          "description": "Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation."
        },
        "warnings": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Non-fatal warnings the agent should consider.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/warningInfo"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "ok",
        "error",
        "diagnostics"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "ok": {
          "const": false,
          "description": "Whether the tool invocation succeeded."
        },
        "error": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "code",
            "message",
            "correlationId"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "code": {
              "const": "UnhandledException"
            },
            "message": {
              "const": "Tool execution failed."
            },
            "correlationId": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          },
          "description": "Structured error details when the invocation failed."
        },
        "diagnostics": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "detailsAvailable",
            "detailsTool"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "detailsAvailable": {
              "const": true
            },
            "detailsTool": {
              "const": "get-error-details"
            }
          },
          "description": "Diagnostics that explain the failed invocation."
        },
        "reporting": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "state": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "Available",
                "AlwaysApproved",
                "DisabledByConfiguration",
                "ApprovalUnavailable"
              ]
            },
            "canPrepare": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "prepareTool": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ]
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "state"
          ],
          "description": "Error-reporting workflow available for an unhandled failure."
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "warningInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "description": "The stable machine-readable warning code.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "message": {
          "description": "The human-readable warning message.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "message"
      ]
    }
  }
}
